result.final_text:
## What this letter says
Your scan on 22 September 2026 showed you are 10 weeks pregnant. This is confirmed. The scan is called a dating scan.
The letter tells you to keep taking your medicine (sertraline). It also gives you a date to see the midwife.

## What you need to do
1. Keep taking sertraline 50 milligrams once a day.
2. Go to your booking appointment with the midwife. It is on Tuesday 13 October 2026 at 10:00.

## Dates and medicines
- 22 September 2026: your dating scan.
- Tuesday 13 October 2026 at 10:00: your booking appointment with the midwife.
- Sertraline: 50 milligrams, once a day. There is no change. Continue as before.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- What will happen at my booking appointment with the midwife?
- Do I need to bring anything to the appointment?
- Who do I talk to if I have questions about my sertraline?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
